Theme-Colored Quote Blocks

"You can't google my hood." — Place (chartreuse)
"How do you phantom limb a street?" — Loss (coral)
"I stepped on Zac Efron and Vanessa Hudgens every day." — Intimacy (gold)
"I can't even find a picture of them on Google to prove they were real." — Web (cyan)
"I grew up to love ghetto." — Identity (orchid)
"I thought poetry was what you went to when you wanted to talk about what you thought god was." — Expression (mint)
"San Diego of the future, my hope is that you still hold space for community." — Future (silver)
"We looked out for each other." — Care (cherry blossom)
"It gives people a chance to be seen." — Witness (lavender)
"This gentrification is contributing to the pillars of the communities leaving town." — Surveillance (blue)
"Destiny is passive. This isn't destiny." — Emergence (emerald)
"They were my dad's from the 80s... they fit." — Threshold (pale violet)
